jobs.title: Part-Time Armed Security Officer: Government Access Control
jobs.description:
Allied Universal, a leading security services provider, seeks a Security Officer Armed Credential Control in Houston, TX for a part-time role. You will manage access control, monitor entry points, and maintain a secure environment at a government location with routine patrols and incident reporting.

The position requires armed credentials, a high school diploma or GED, and a college degree, with a focus on reliable, communicative service and adherence to protocols.
